name: My views
description: A calm New Tab page of your own: the field at the foot of the page, and over it the folder, the chats that need you and a few recent chats as quiet rows.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats (title, state, folder) to list the recent ones and the ones that need you.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click its row.
scopes.actions:run: Start a chat from the field and open a chat that has no workspace.
